declare
 m_count number(4) ;
 /* Following varibles are declared to handle Timezone changes */
 v_from_date DATE := :from_date;
 v_to_date DATE := :to_date ;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 
 /* Belowcode added to implement changes with respect to timezone requirement */
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:from_date,v_from_date);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:to_date,v_to_date);
 else
 v_from_date := :from_date;
 v_to_date := :to_date ;
 end if;
 select count(*) into m_count
 from remote_test_batch
 where to_date(to_char(submit_date,'MM-DD-RR'),'MM-DD-RR') 
 between to_date(to_char(v_from_date,'MM-DD-RR'),'MM-DD-RR') 
 and to_date(to_char(v_to_date,'MM-DD-RR'),'MM-DD-RR')
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 go_block('sample_query') ;
 clear_block ;
 if m_count > 0 then
 :GLOBAL.sample_flag := 0 ;
 execute_query ;
 else
 :GLOBAL.sample_flag := 1 ;
 end if;
 go_block('results_query') ;
 clear_block ;
 populate_results_info ;
 first_record ;
 if :GLOBAL.sample_flag = 0 then
 go_block('sample_query') ;
 :sample_query.s_highlighter := '>';
 elsif :GLOBAL.results_flag = 0 then
 go_block('results_query') ;
 :results_query.s_highlighter := '>';
 else
 GO_ITEM('file_type_select') ;
 show_error('2105') ;
 end if;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CONVERT_DIFF
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure convert_diff (diff_char out VARCHAR2) is
 upload_number number(5) ;
 cutoff_number number(5) ;
 diff_number number(7,2) ;
 diff_hrs integer(2) ;
 diff_mins integer(2) ;
begin
 /*----------------------------------------------------------
 This procedure calculates the difference between upload time and
 cut-off time.
 First, the upload time is converted into minutes using
 hour portion * 60 + minute portion. Cutoff, being a time field,
 has to be divided by 60 to convert into minutes.Then the
 difference between the two numbers are calculated. This difference
 is the difference
 between the two times in minutes. Then the hour portion and
 minute portion is calculated. They are concatenated with padding of
 '0' whenever necessary. The treatment of positive time difference
 and negative time difference varies slightly from each other.
 ------------------------------------------------------------- */
 upload_number := to_number(substr(:upload_time,1,2)) * 60 +
 to_number(substr(:upload_time,4,5)) ;
 cutoff_number := to_number(:cutoff/60) ;
 diff_number := upload_number - cutoff_number ;
 if diff_number >= 0 then
 diff_hrs := floor(diff_number / 60) ;
 diff_mins := diff_number - diff_hrs*60 ;
 diff_char := ' ';
 else
 diff_hrs := abs(ceil(diff_number / 60)) ;
 diff_mins := abs(diff_number) - diff_hrs*60 ;
 diff_char := '-' ;
 end if;
 /* If hour is between 0 and 9, '0' has to be padded */
 if NVL(length(to_char(diff_hrs)), 0) = 1 then
 diff_char:= diff_char || '0' || to_char(diff_hrs) ||':';
 else
 diff_char:= diff_char || to_char(diff_hrs) || ':';
 end if;
 /* If minute is between 0 and 9, '0' has to be padded */
 if NVL(length(to_char(diff_mins)), 0) = 1 then
 diff_char:= diff_char || '0' || to_char(diff_mins) ;
 else
 diff_char:= diff_char || to_char(diff_mins) ;
 end if;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_RESULT_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure populate_result_units is
 v_unit_id varchar2(15) ;
 v_coll_date date;
 cursor c1 is select
-- HCL distinct rid.unit_id, to_char(units.coll_date,'MM-DD-YY')
 distinct rid.unit_id, to_char(units.coll_date,'DD-MON-YYYY')
 from result_inp_dtl rid, result_inp_hdr rih, units 
 where rih.file_name = :results_query.file_name
 and rih.file_type = :results_query.file_type
 and rih.tb_id = rid.tb_id
 and rid.unit_id = units.unit_id (+);
begin
 go_block('result_units') ;
 clear_block ;
 open c1 ;
 loop
 fetch c1 into v_unit_id, v_coll_date ;
 exit when c1%notfound ;
 :result_units.unit_id := v_unit_id ;
 :result_units.coll_date := v_coll_date ;
 -- Added by HCL to calculate check digit
 :result_units.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:result_units.unit_id, null, null);
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 close c1 ;
 first_record ;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_RESULTS_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure populate_results_info is
 m_filecount number(5) ;
 m_counter number(5) ;
 m_tb_id VARCHAR2(15) ;
 m_count number(5) ;
 m_received_date date ;
 m_file_type VARCHAR2(1) ;
 diff_char VARCHAR2(6) ;
 v_local_time date;
 /* New variable to hold from and to date values */
 v_from_date DATE;
 v_to_date DATE;
 
 /* Following cusor remodelled to accept coverted GMT time 
 cursor c_file_names is
 select distinct file_name from result_inp_hdr
 where received_date between :from_date and :to_date
 order by file_name ;
 */
 cursor c_file_names (c_from_date DATE,
 c_to_date DATE
 )
 is
 select distinct file_name 
 from result_inp_hdr
 where received_date 
 between c_from_date 
 and c_to_date
 order by file_name ;

begin
 /* Follwing piece of code converts the date values of from_date and to_date
 fields to match the date values that are in GMT in database
 */
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:from_date,v_from_date);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:to_date,v_to_date);
 else
 v_from_date := :from_date;
 v_to_date := :to_date ;
 end if;
 
 m_counter := 0 ;
 /* Get the count of files uploaded between from date and to date */
 select count(distinct file_name) into m_filecount
 from result_inp_hdr
 where received_date between v_from_date and v_to_date; 
 --where received_date between :from_date and :to_date; -- Commented to make way for the where clause above as part of Timezone changes.
 
 /* For each file, get received date and unit level count. Query to
 fetch received date is executed for rownum = 1 to avoid
 exception TOO_MANY_ROWS. */
 for c1rec in c_file_names(v_from_date,v_to_date) 
 loop
 select received_date,file_type into m_received_date, m_file_type
 from result_inp_hdr
 where file_name = c1rec.file_name
 and rownum = 1 ;
 if :file_type_select is not null then
 if m_file_type != :file_type_select then
 goto end_loop ;
 end if;
 end if;
 m_counter := m_counter + 1 ;
 select count(distinct unit_id) into m_count
 from result_inp_dtl
 where tb_id in (select tb_id from result_inp_hdr
 where file_name = c1rec.file_name) ;
 --
 if m_received_date is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,m_received_date,v_local_time);
 m_received_date := v_local_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- 
 :received_date := m_received_date ;
 :upload_time := to_char(m_received_date,'HH24:MI') ;
 :day := to_char(m_received_date,'DY') ;
 convert_diff(diff_char) ;
 :diff := diff_char ;
 if substr(diff_char,1,1) = '-' or
 ( substr(diff_char,2,2) ='00' and substr(diff_char,5,2) = '00')
 then
 :s_star := ' ' ;
 else
 :s_star := '*' ;
 end if ;
 :file_name := c1rec.file_name ;
 :file_type := m_file_type ;
 :results_recd_count := m_count ;
 /* Following if..then is to ensure that a blank record is not
 displayed at the end. */
 if m_counter < m_filecount then
 next_record ;
 end if;
 <<end_loop>>
 null;
 end loop ;
 if m_counter = 0 then
 :GLOBAL.results_flag := 1 ;
 else
 :GLOBAL.results_flag := 0;
 end if;
end ;
